about.reviews.new_accounts.defaultMessage: {what}，限帳號建立未滿 {days, plural, other {# 天}} 者

about.auto_delete.articles.description: A kind of post people may keep from the automatic deletion, in the list of about.auto_delete.keep.

about.crawlers.ai.description: What the server states to AI crawlers, on the about page, after about.crawlers.search.

about.crawlers.how.defaultMessage: 此聲明位於此伺服器的 robots.txt、頁面的標籤與標頭，以及它的 TDMRep 檔案中。它只涵蓋此伺服器的頁面：其他伺服器各有自己的聲明，媒體檔案則只帶有伺服器的聲明。

about.crawlers.legal.defaultMessage: 這類聲明在法律上的意義因國家而異，許多營運者是自願遵守。本文不構成法律意見。

about.crawlers.crawler.description: The row of the about page that opens the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.intro.defaultMessage: 當此伺服器上的貼文連結到某個網頁時，伺服器會擷取該頁面，顯示含標題、說明和圖片的卡片。本頁寫給經營這些網站的人：這些請求是什麼，以及如何拒絕。
about.crawler.intro.description: Opening paragraph of the page about the link card crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.state.ignores.description: What the crawler does on a server whose setting link_cards_ignore_robots_txt is on: at the top of the page about the crawler. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.state.off.defaultMessage: 在此伺服器上，連結卡片已關閉，所以爬蟲目前不會擷取任何內容。本頁其餘部分說明它在開啟時的行為。

about.crawler.identity.user_agent.description: Sentence before the User-Agent of the crawler, shown as code. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.identity.token.description: Explains the User-Agent of the crawler and the name it goes by. my-linkcard is a literal name: do not translate it. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.identity.others.defaultMessage: 此伺服器的其他請求（例如聯邦宇宙的請求）使用 my/ 這個名稱，本頁不涵蓋這些請求。其中兩種可能接在卡片之後：它可能以 my/ 再次擷取卡片的圖片，以便顯示給讀者；它也會查詢頁面在 fediverse:creator 中指明的帳號。
about.crawler.identity.others.description: Other requests of the server that a site operator can see, under the server's general User-Agent. my/ and fediverse:creator are literal: do not translate them. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.trigger.title.description: Heading of the section that says what makes the crawler fetch a URL. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.trigger.post.defaultMessage: 有貼文連結到該 URL。伺服器會用貼文內文中的第一個連結製作卡片，不論貼文的可見範圍為何；如果沒有近期的卡片，就會擷取該頁面。

about.crawler.trigger.remote.defaultMessage: 這包括來自其他伺服器的貼文，而不只是在此處撰寫的貼文，所以收到請求並不代表此處有人讀過你的頁面。

about.crawler.sends.headers.defaultMessage: 上述 User-Agent、它接受的內容類型，以及請求頁面時，在 Accept-Language 中帶上的此伺服器預設語言。

about.crawler.opt_out.robots.ignored.defaultMessage: 此伺服器不讀取 robots.txt，所以這條規則在此沒有作用。它適用於遵守 robots.txt 的伺服器。

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.caption.description: The name, for assistive technology, of the table of what each directive of a page changes in a card, on the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.directi.description: Column header: a page directive. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.effect.description: Column header: what the directive does to the card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.nosnipp.description: What the directives nosnippet and max-snippet:0 do to a card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noimage.defaultMessage: 沒有圖片，也不會請求圖片。
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noimage.description: What the directives noimageindex and max-image-preview:none do to a card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noindex.defaultMessage: 沒有變化。這些指令要求不出現在搜尋結果中，而卡片不是搜尋結果：它只因為有人貼出連結才出現，而且許多不出現在搜尋結果的頁面本來就是要被分享的。若要在此伺服器上拒絕，請聯絡管理員。
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.noindex.description: What the directives noindex and none do to a card, on a server that does not read robots.txt. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.rest.defaultMessage: 無論使用哪個指令，標題、網站名稱和作者都會保留。
about.crawler.opt_out.directives.rest.description: What no page directive removes from a card. On the page for the operators of websites on this server's link card crawler.

about.crawler.opt_out.directives.where.defaultMessage: 請寫在頁面 head 中名為 robots 或 my-linkcard 的 meta 標籤，或寫在 X-Robots-Tag 標頭中：
